summary: HeartBeam, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the mutual departure of CEO Robert P. Eno effective June 30, 2026, along with his resignation from the Board, and the immediate resignation of director Mark Strome, both without dispute. The CEO departure is part of a strategic reorganization; Founder Branislav Vajdic and Executive Chairman Rich Ferrari will lead operations, with Vajdic serving as principal executive officer. No severance terms or consideration are disclosed beyond a potential consulting agreement and release of claims. No acquisition, tender, or special-meeting event is involved. Watch for appointment of a permanent CEO and any further restructuring details.
